item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 8:05 AM, 07 November 2026(Saturday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Bulacan (Dona Remedios Trinidad, San Miguel, San Ildefonso, and San Rafael), Laguna (Santa Maria, Siniloan, and Famy), Nueva Ecija (General Tinio), Quezon (General Nakar, Infanta, Panukulan, Burdeos, Candelaria, Sariaya, Tayabas, Lucban, Lucena, Pagbilao, Sampaloc, Calauag, Jomalig, Patnanungan, Polillo, Tagkawayan, Guinayangan, Real, Quezon, Alabat, Perez, Lopez, Atimonan, Plaridel, and Padre Burgos), and Rizal (Tanay) within the next 3 hours.

The above condition is affecting Quezon (Mauban) which may persist within 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
